featured.title: Semiprime Factorization with Discrete Diffusion and Beam Search: Scaling Laws
featured.tldr: A discrete-diffusion transformer learns to factor semiprimes up to 68 bits, but scaling laws show compute grows exponentially with bit length, so RSA is not threatened.

featured.title: An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models
featured.tldr: Exponential residual flows give discrete diffusion language models an analogue of the probability-flow ODE: after one random draw, sampling is deterministic yet provably keeps the right distributions, enabling consistency distillation.

featured.title: ALoDLM: Adaptively Looped Diffusion Language Models
featured.tldr: ALoDLM lets a diffusion language model spend extra recurrent computation only on hard-to-predict tokens, beating comparable Qwen3 autoregressive models on average across 11 benchmarks with about 2.7x the throughput on GSM8K.
